description: This file contains the implementation of distributed collective operation functions for PyTorch, specifically focusing on legacy (c10d_functional) collectives that internally call into newer functional collectives via torch.ops. It defines various functions such as broadcast, all_reduce, all_gather_into_tensor, reduce_scatter_tensor, and others, which are used for distributed tensor operations.

methods.name: _broadcast(input, src, tag, ranks, group_size)
methods.description: Performs a broadcast operation across distributed processes using torch.ops._c10d_functional.broadcast.

methods.name: _all_reduce(input, reduce_op, tag, ranks, group_size)
methods.description: Performs an all-reduce operation with a specified reduction operation across distributed processes.

methods.name: _all_reduce_coalesced(inputs, reduce_op, tag, ranks, group_size)
methods.description: Performs a coalesced all-reduce operation on multiple tensors.

methods.name: _all_gather_into_tensor(input, tag, ranks, group_size)
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation into a tensor.

methods.name: _all_gather_into_tensor_coalesced(input, tag, ranks, group_size)
methods.description: Performs a coalesced all-gather operation into tensors.

methods.name: _reduce_scatter_tensor( input: torch.Tensor, reduce_op: str, tag: str, ranks: list[int], group_size: int, )
methods.description: Performs a reduce-scatter operation on a tensor.

methods.name: _reduce_scatter_tensor_coalesced( inputs: list[torch.Tensor], reduce_op: str, tag: str, ranks: list[int], group_size: int, )
methods.description: Performs a coalesced reduce-scatter operation on multiple tensors.

methods.name: _all_to_all_single( input: torch.Tensor, output_split_sizes: list[int] | None, input_split_sizes: list[int] | None, tag: str, ranks: list[int], group_size: int, )
methods.description: Performs an all-to-all operation on a tensor, with optional splitting sizes.

methods.name: torch.Tensor _wait_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Waits for a tensor operation to complete.
